storage_revision.precedence: This docket is the current authoritative Odyssey policy record; the explicit 120 GiB private-write cap is retained alongside the 25 GiB device free floor.
storage_revision.private_write_cap: 120 GiB maximum private-write envelope; G07 must measure actual P95 growth and remain below this cap
storage_revision.admission_formula: runtime_free_floor plus P95 total projected 7-day growth across all eight lanes
storage_revision.runtime_floor_formula: 25 GiB device floor plus any separately staged model bytes plus width-eight concurrent transient bound plus terminal allowance

model_selection.policy: one shared locally hosted open-weight reasoning base across A-H; no frontier-specific base models
model_selection.selection_rule: choose the strongest eligible locally available model on frozen public canaries before hidden seeds are generated
eligibility: pinned weight, tokenizer, runtime, and quantization digests
shared model-service footprint at or below 24 GiB
full width-eight admission under the 85 GiB resident campaign cap
stable local availability for the full seven days

arms.candidate_treatment: L1_associative_monolith with endogenous durable developmental updates: associative writes, correction assimilation, competence updates, unfinished-task persistence, owned cognitive-state consolidation, and checkpointed continuation across model/tool/body/process replacement
arms.matched_control: the identical pinned base model, observations, schedules, specialist tools, token and compute budgets, storage allowance, and append-only project-state/history retrieval, with endogenous developmental rewriting disabled
arms.causal_difference: the ability to transform experience into owned persistent associative developmental state

requirements: license, hash, causal-role, split, and leakage card for every source
original cases and public-domain abstractions for philosophy
bounded selected real trajectories plus generated scenes for robotics/3D

rules: no person may hold both the task seed and evaluator answer material for the same frontier
Day-7 signatories may not sign frontiers whose task materials they held
do not claim eight independent humans when lane custody identities map to four real task custodians
if genuine independence cannot be obtained, downgrade to single-operator cryptographic blinding and prohibit the strongest independent-custody claim
custody_policy.identity_state: real human identities and commitments still required

limits.storage_policy: 25 GiB device-free floor plus measured dynamic private-write capacity bounded by a 120 GiB maximum private-write cap
